title: Local immunotherapy in experimental murine lung inflammation
protocol: Reconstitute the reagent according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Store the reconstituted reagent at 4 °C or -20 °C.
Perform dilution of the reagent under sterile conditions.
Prepare aliquots if necessary.
Dilute the reagent in PBS for delivery, typically 25-50 μl per mouse.
Store diluted reagent at 4 °C for a few hours, but prepare immediately before usage.
Warm the reagent to room temperature before application.
Anesthetize mice with isoflurane.
Alternatively, anesthetize mice with Avertin prepared as specified in MATERIALS.
As another option, anesthetize mice with ketamine prepared according to MATERIALS.
Weigh 5 mg of Ovalbumin.
Dispense the weighed Ovalbumin in 10 ml of 0.9% NaCl.
Dissolve 1 g of Aluminium potassium sulphate (alum) in 10 ml distilled water.
Add alum solution to the OVA solution and adjust pH to 6.5 using NaOH.
Incubate the mixture for 1 hour at room temperature with gentle shaking.
Centrifuge the OVA/alum solution for 5 minutes at 1500 rpm, 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the precipitate in distilled water to make a final volume of 10 ml.
Mix thoroughly.
Store the prepared OVA/alum solution at 4°C and use on the same day or next day if stored overnight.
Inject mice in the asthma untreated and treated groups with 200 µl of OVA/alum intraperitoneally (i.p.) on days 0 and 7.
Inject control group mice with PBS complexed with alum at the same time points as for OVA/alum.
Treat mice in asthma untreated and treated groups with 25-50 µl of OVA intranasally (i.n.) on days 25, 26, and 27.
Alternatively, administer OVA or PBS as an aerosol to the respective groups.
For the asthma treated group, inject 25-50 µl of indicated treatment i.n., 30 minutes to 2 hours prior to allergen challenge on days 25-27.
Perform airway hyperresponsiveness (AHR) measurements at day 28.
Collect bronchoalveolar lavage fluid (BALF) and lung cell suspension as previously described.
Test substances of interest in vitro in cell culture experiments before applying them in vivo.
Dilute the reagent to the appropriate concentration as described in REAGENT SETUP.
Store the diluted reagent on ice.
Anesthetize the mouse with isoflurane for 30 seconds to one minute using the equipment's mouse box.
Remove the mouse from the mouse box when it stops moving and its breathing slows slightly.
Take 25-50 μl of the solution into a pipette.
Hold the mouse by the neck to stabilize its head, fixing the tail with fingers.
Bend the mouse’s head back slightly to clear respiratory passages.
Pipette the solution carefully and slowly onto the nose of the mouse.
Place the mouse back into its cage.
Ensure the mouse is awake and well after the procedure.
Sacrifice the mice at the end of the experiment.
Remove and analyze the lungs as described in Sauer et al. and Maxeiner et al.
Optionally, measure airway hyperreactivity.
Take blood samples if necessary.
Perform a broncho-alveolar lavage if required.
